'''Fleek oil''' was a type of oil.<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] once compared the high humidity of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] to wading through a pool of heated fleek oil.<ref name="MedStar I" />
